name: Harem Sennou ADV Game ~Sennou Kyoudan
original_name: ハーレム洗脳ADVゲーム～洗脳教団
source:
A dubious church seems to be behind the disappearance of young ladies. Investigator Kanemori infiltrates the cult and discovers a system of brainwashing and sex trafficking, whereby the ladies are sold to owners on the human market. At the center of the mystery is a beautiful woman and a man known as the Father. Kanemori intends to save the young ladies from the cult.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130588.html]DLsite English[/url]]
